# medea_flutter_webrtc

**Tag**: web, mobile, desktop, ui, tooling

## 简介

Flutter WebRTC plugin for Android/iOS/macOS/Linux/Windows/Web, based on GoogleWebRTC, designed for and used in Medea Jason WebRTC client.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/instrumentisto/medea-flutter-webrtc
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/medea_flutter_webrtc
